---
title: "Roadmap and Current Status"
---

## Current status

| Surface | State |
|---|---|
| Documentation and public contracts | Phase-1 candidate; not integrated |
| Installable/importable package and version metadata | Implemented and CI-validated in a separate runtime candidate; not integrated |
| `scgsim.palace` | Planned; not implemented |
| `scgsim.aedt` | Planned; not implemented |
| Common run/handoff and profiles | Planned; not implemented |
| Unified reports | Planned; not implemented |
| Notebook interfaces | Planned; not implemented |

The exact `develop` base remains empty of product code. The separate runtime
candidate provides only package/version metadata and build/CI packaging checks:
Python `~=3.12.0`, `scgsim.__version__ == "0.1.0.dev0"`, and no runtime
dependencies. This site therefore does not provide installation or execution
instructions yet.

## Near term

1. Integrate the documentation and package/version scaffold candidates.
2. Define the common artifact, profile, receipt, and handoff models.
3. Implement Palace Electrostatic and Eigenmode, emphasizing Surface EPR.
4. Implement version-locked PyAEDT paths for HFSS Eigenmode, HFSS Driven
   Modal/Terminal, Q3D, and Q2D.
5. Add notebook contracts and Plotly reports only as real APIs become available.

## Later

- Palace Driven
- Palace Magnetostatic

Meep remains excluded.
